name: Wildsense
description: Sites on forest and swamp are known the moment you arrive.

name: Verdant Passage
description: For your next 12 tiles, forest and swamp cost the same as open ground.

name: Beast Envoy
description: Send a beast to a tile within 6. The nearest patrol follows it for 6 steps instead of hunting or raiding.

name: Thornwall
description: Patrols cannot enter the chosen adjacent hex for 8 party steps. (S3: patrol APIs)
